warnings: Historical screening only: confirmed=1 is provisional and is not the final scientific outcome definition.
Counts represent final retrospectively confirmed records, not information proven available at a historical prediction time.
A zero means no eligible records observed in this extraction; negative notification and absence of infections are not verified.
The 2013 notification/symptom anomaly is retained without correction or exclusion based on notification dates.
No cross-file, person or episode deduplication is applied or certified.
W-SUN Monday-Sunday has not been validated as equivalent to the official INS epidemiological calendar.
n_days measures the authorized calendar-window intersection, not verified daily surveillance or raster coverage.
The 78 candidate municipalities were selected retrospectively using the full 2007-2025 period; final municipalities remain undecided.
Covariate completeness does not certify meteorological accuracy or historical operational availability.
Manifest source row counts are checked against caches; original source Excel files are not re-audited.
Population discontinuities, including Montelibano 2008, and fixed MGN-2025 areas are preserved.
No labels, endemic channels, lags, predictive horizons, train/test splits or models are constructed.

data_dictionary.municipality_code: Five-digit occurrence DIVIPOLA code; integration key, including leading zeros.
data_dictionary.municipality: Descriptive name supplied by integrated covariates; never a join key.
data_dictionary.week_start: Monday start of W-SUN interval; date, integration key.
data_dictionary.population: Annual DANE population assigned by year of week_start; not certified INS at-risk population.
data_dictionary.area_km2: Fixed municipal MGN-2025 area in square kilometres.
data_dictionary.population_density_km2: Annual population / fixed area, inhabitants per square kilometre.
data_dictionary.temperature_c: Municipal weekly ERA5-Land mean air temperature at 2 m, degrees Celsius.
data_dictionary.precipitation_mm: Municipal mean CHIRPS accumulated precipitation over available interval days, millimetres.
data_dictionary.relative_humidity_pct: Estimated relative humidity from ERA5-Land daily mean temperature/dew point, percent.
data_dictionary.confirmed_records_screening: Count of retrospectively confirmed eligible source rows under the provisional historical screening rule; not unique people/episodes.
data_dictionary.no_eligible_records_observed: True exactly when screening count is zero; does not assert verified negative notification.
data_dictionary.week_end_nominal: Sunday nominal end, inclusive; can lie beyond the authorized window.
data_dictionary.n_days: Number of calendar days intersecting authorized window, inclusive; does not measure source completeness.
data_dictionary.partial_week: True when n_days < 7; the last interval has three days and is retained without extrapolation.

configuration_path_convention: Repository-relative paths; external:<input_name> aliases require explicit local CLI paths and are identified by source fingerprints.
